item.title: Fast food restaurants are informal gathering spaces for college students
item.description: Whether it’s a quick meal, late night study session or socializing with friends, fast food restaurants can provide small meaningful moments to cherish. Kari Vogelgesang, a clinical associate professor at the University of Iowa, defines “third spaces” as the places outside home and school or work where people gather, linger and connect. item.description: UA student Hector Gutierrez was transformed into a campus celebrity Wednesday evening after he accidentally emailed an Honor Society Eligibility Listserv with a letter of recommendation an instructor wrote for him.
